seo_audit.name: SEO audit
sections: Executive summary — score, the 3 fixes that matter most, expected impact
Scorecard — table: area, status (good / needs work / critical), issues found
Technical and on-page findings — table: page, issue, impact, fix
Content and keyword opportunities — table: query, page, position, impressions, action
Prioritised action plan — table: action, owner, effort (S/M/L), impact, by when
Method and data — data snapshot date, what was checked, what was not
checklist: Every issue names the page and the fix
Numbers come from the audit data
Actions have an owner and a date

blog_brief.name: Blog post brief
sections: Working title and meta — title under 60 characters, meta description 120-155 characters, URL slug
Search intent and reader — who searches, what they need, the job to be done
Keywords — primary, 3-6 secondary, questions people ask
Outline — H2/H3 structure with 1-2 lines on what each section must say
Proof and sources — approved customer results and public sources to cite
Internal links and call to action
Brand notes — tone, words to avoid, product names
checklist: Primary keyword in title, H1, first 100 words and meta

blog_post.name: Blog post
sections: 3-5 H2 sections answering the search intent

content_calendar.name: Social content calendar
content_calendar.length: one row per post; hook and copy under the channel limits
sections: Sheet 'Calendar' — date, day, time, channel, pillar, format, hook, post copy, call to action, hashtags, asset, status
Sheet 'Pillar mix' — planned share vs target share per pillar
Sheet 'Notes' — campaign moments, blackout dates, approvals needed
checklist: Pillar mix within 5 points of target
Hashtags from the approved list, max 3
No prospects or unapproved customers named

proposal.name: Client proposal
sections: Executive summary — their goal, our recommendation, investment and timeline in 5 lines
Your situation — the client's pains in their own words, with their numbers
What we propose — scope, products and what is included
Plan and timeline — phases, milestones, go-live date and assumptions
Investment — prices exactly as given in the brief, with terms
Proof — approved customer results relevant to the client
Why us — 3 reasons tied to their criteria
Next steps — dated actions and owners
checklist: Prices exactly as in the brief
Client's own words for the pain

pitch_deck.name: Pitch deck
pitch_deck.length: 7-10 slides, at most 6 bullets per slide, speaker notes on key slides
checklist: Numbers from the brief or approved results
Last slide is a dated next step

sop.name: Standard operating procedure
sections: Roles — RACI table (exactly one A per row)
Procedure — numbered steps: action (imperative verb), owner, system, done when
checklist: Every step starts with a verb and has one owner

gtm_plan.name: Go-to-market plan
sections: Market and segment — sizing with method and sources
Channels and launch plan — phased timeline
checklist: Market numbers cite a source or are labelled estimates

whitepaper.name: Whitepaper
sections: The problem — industry context with cited sources

press_release.name: Press release
sections: Dateline and lead paragraph — who, what, when, where, why
checklist: Status words match approved facts (beta vs generally available)
